newsitem.title: USA: Farm Bureau agrees to buy United Home Life.
newsitem.headline: Farm Bureau agrees to buy United Home Life.

text.p: Farm Bureau Insurance and United Home Life Insurance Co said Thursday they signed a definitive agreement under which Farm Bureau will acquire United Home for $8.75 a share cash or about $10.582 million.

The deal is subject to the approval of the Indiana Department of Insurance, United Home Life's shareholders and certain other conditions. Olive Corporate Finance LLC is acting as financial adviser to United Home Life.
United Home Life, based in Greenwood, Indiana, is licensed to sell life insurance in 25 states and the District of Columbia.
Farm Bureau Insurance is a member of the Indiana Farm Bureau family of companies.
